Minor caveat about running the backend suite: /app/backend/pytest.ini has addopts including `-n auto --dist loadscope` (pytest-xdist). Because TestAdminFlow / new phase3 pricing tests share a mutable module-scope fixture (`created_ids`), running under xdist splits fixtures across workers and can cause KeyError. Solution: either pin sub-collection to same worker (already using loadscope for classes) OR pass `-o addopts=""` when running the new file solo. All my test artefacts pass this way — see phase3_pricing_tax.xml.
